definition: In this context, disadvantaged refers to having socioeconomic conditions or constraints that place a student at a relative disadvantage in learning, such as making it harder to sustain self-regulated learning and fully participate or achieve in school. It describes a background linked with fewer supports or opportunities and greater risk of persistent academic gaps.
